reasons: Cited text supports the compliant classification: Section 9.4 grants Customer an unconditional right to terminate the Agreement or any Order Form without cause, and Section 29.4 sets the notice at thirty days before the effective termination date, matching the preferred 30-day written-notice position.

No early-termination fee or penalty is imposed — Customer owes only accrued Fees and Vendor must refund prepaid Fees for the post-termination period (reinforced by Section 10.2), satisfying the pro-rata refund element.

The rationale correctly notes the three-year term in Section 8.1 and that Vendor's termination rights are confined to material breach (9.1) and insolvency (9.2), so no Vendor convenience right undercuts the committed term; nothing in the supplied text contradicts this.
Consistent with a compliant finding, the redline leaves all paragraphs unchanged and no counterparty comment is proposed; the deterministic check confirming a Customer convenience right also aligns.
